load.advice_low: This week weighs much less than usual. Fine after a rest or a deload week; otherwise, build back up gradually.
load.advice_optimal: This week is close to what your body is used to. Keep it up.
load.advice_caution: You are doing clearly more than usual. Keep the next days lighter and look after your sleep.
load.advice_danger: Far more than usual in one week: the body needs time to adapt. Ease off for a few days and listen to how you feel.
load.coach_low: This athlete is training much less than usual this week.
load.coach_optimal: Their load stays close to what they are used to.
load.coach_caution: This athlete is doing clearly more than usual: plan lighter days.
load.coach_danger: Their load jumped well above usual this week: ease it off and check how they feel.
load.weeksLabel: Load of the last four weeks: {weeks}
load.how: Each session counts its minutes times how hard it felt (RPE; without an RPE, an average effort for the kind of session). The last 7 days are compared with the average of the last 4 weeks; between 0.8 and 1.3 the load stays close to usual. A guide to dose your training, to read with how you feel, not a prediction of injury.

aiConsent.title: Your agreement before using the AI

aiConsent.never: No name, email or notes. Nothing leaves before each request, and you can withdraw this agreement at any time in Settings.

strava.errRate: Strava limits the number of requests: try again in 15 minutes.

homeZones.loadText: Go lighter the next few days
homeZones.competitionSoon: {count, plural, =0 {Competition today} one {Competition in # day} other {Competition in # days}}

planB.title: My plan B
planB.hint: What you do on a day the planned session does not fit, or when nothing is planned: offered in one tap from the session card.
planB.shorterText: The time you have, the same session
planB.chooseText: HIIT, mobility, an outing or a program day, set once
planB.moveText: To another day of the week

sportSwitch.title: My sport
sportSwitch.hint: The home screen, the sessions offered and the figures follow this sport. Your programs and data do not change.

displayMode.title: Display
displayMode.desc_essential: Today’s session, programs, history and simple progress. Ideal to start with.
displayMode.desc_complete: Adds the follow-up: advice, reports, form, nutrition and tools.
displayMode.desc_expert: Everything, including the finer indicators: ACWR load, TRIMP, volume per muscle.
displayMode.settingsHint: What the app shows. Nothing is lost when you switch: your data stays, and safety alerts (injury, low form, load rising too fast) show in every mode.
displayMode.onboardingQuestion: How would you like to see the app?
displayMode.onboardingHint: You can change it anytime in Settings.
displayMode.adminIntro: The first mode that shows each part: “Essential” shows it everywhere, “Expert” only in Expert mode. Safety alerts (injury, low form, load rising too fast) are not listed: they always show. Settings and Profile always stay in the menu.
displayMode.adminMissing: The mapping is not in the database yet: apply migration 082.

music.title: Music
music.chooseHint: The session goes on meanwhile. Change the app or add a playlist in Settings > Music.
music.settingsHint: The Music button of the sessions opens your music app, on your playlist if you give one; the session goes on meanwhile. Kept on this device.
music.playlistHint: In {app}, Share > Copy the playlist link, then paste it here.
music.playlistInvalid: This link is not a {app} playlist.
music.soundHint: On iPhone, the beeps mix with the music and then follow the silent switch; the coach's voice, though, pauses it.
music.notLoaded: The list of music apps has not been loaded yet: open the app once with a connection.
music.adminIntro: The apps an athlete can open from a session: its address on a phone ("spotify:"), its web player on a computer, and how its playlist links begin, one per line.
music.adminPrefixes: Playlist links begin with (https, one per line)
music.adminInvalid: Incomplete list: each app needs a name, a unique identifier, an app address and https links.
music.adminMissing: The list of music apps does not exist yet: apply migration 083.
music.voiceOff: Voice coach off: on iPhone, the voice would pause your music. The beeps take over.
music.voiceCoachHint: Announces each exercise of timed sessions (HIIT, mobility). On iPhone, the voice pauses your music: it turns off when you start music from a session, and the beeps take over.

boxingAdmin.title: Boxing rounds
boxingAdmin.intro: What boxing sessions are built from: the lengths and round formats offered ("180-60" = a 3-minute round, 60 s of rest), the usual format by level, how long a combination lasts, the order of the kinds in a round (the burst ends it) and the combinations, which are library exercises (translated names, descriptions, videos, injury rules).
boxingAdmin.missing: The boxing rounds reference does not exist yet: apply migration 085.
boxingAdmin.rhythm: Order of the kinds in a round
boxingAdmin.rhythmHint: attack, defense or footwork, separated by commas; the burst (finisher) ends each round.
boxingAdmin.invalid: Incomplete reference: each format must hold at least two whole combinations, each level an offered format, and there must be at least one attack.

bodyMap.filterHint: Tap a muscle, on the body or in the list, to choose it; a second time to rule it out; a third to clear it.
bodyMap.count: {count, plural, =0 {No exercise} one {# exercise} other {# exercises}}
bodyMap.adminHint: Tap a muscle: main, then secondary, then none. With none chosen, the exercise is read from its groups.
bodyMap.notLoaded: The list of muscles has not been loaded yet: open the app once with a connection.

references.missing: This list does not exist yet: apply migration 089.
references.invalid: Incomplete list: each item has a unique id (lowercase letters, digits, “-” or “_”) and a name in the three languages.
references.idHint: The id is kept in the data (exercises, groups): changing it detaches what already uses it. Names change freely.
references.themesHint: Themes “to follow” are flagged when a group has not worked them for three weeks.
references.musclesIntro: The muscles of the filter and of the exercise cards, each in a group. The drawing has a shape for each of the first 17 muscles; one added shows in the lists, not on the drawing.
references.groupsIntro: The exercises' groups, in the order shown everywhere (filters, cards, generated sessions), with their roles.
references.groupsHint: One “unsorted” group only; at most one “whole body” group.
references.role_noRecovery: Left out of “same muscles two days running”
references.role_endurance: Worked in endurance (stretches after an outing)
references.lessonsIntro: For each sport of the group lessons: its themes (in a lesson's order), age bands, levels and equipment.
references.onHorse: Lessons given on a horse (the horse's work is followed)

lessons.title: Group lessons · coach's notebook
lessons.intro: Your groups (tennis, vaulting…), the lessons you plan and those you have given, week after week. Nothing about the players themselves.
lessons.empty: Create your first group: its sport, name, age and weekly slots.
lessons.playersHint: Just a number: no names are kept.
lessons.archived: {count, plural, one {# archived group} other {# archived groups}}
lessons.noSlotThisWeek: No slot this week: add some to your groups.
lessons.themesEmpty: The themes show as soon as lessons are marked as given.
lessons.presentCount: {count, plural, =0 {no one present} one {# present} other {# present}}
lessons.emptyPlan: Add drills, or start from the group's previous lesson.
lessons.intensityHint: Optional: how hard the group found it.
lessons.notePlaceholder: What worked, what still needs work
lessons.notLoaded: The notebook's sports and lists have not been loaded yet: open the app once with a connection.
lessons.teamsHint: Teams without accounts: you plan and follow their lessons, keeping nothing about the students.
lessons.noHorse: No horse: add them in Horses to follow their work.
lessons.horseHint: Added to the horse's work of the week (Horses page).
lessons.ownExerciseHint: Added to the exercise library, for you: you can also put it in a program.
